name: math-tactical-classroom-v60-factorization-boss-teacher
description: Offline Math Tactical classroom Windows installer based on the validated V60.3 Boss Edition, with 90-second factorization questions, a 45-minute mission, PIN-protected teacher direct access to all five rooms, F8 teacher room switching, fast 1–2 hit normal enemies, the three-phase Archive Warden, permanent pickable floor weapons, and encrypted local student results.

scripts.prepare: node scripts/prepare-classroom-v60.js && node scripts/patch-v60-factorization-workshop.js && node scripts/unpack-v61-boss-patch.js && node scripts/patch-v60-boss-v61.js && node scripts/patch-v60-teacher-mode-v604.js && npm run prepare:icons
scripts.test: npm run prepare && node --check school-game/v60/main.js && node --check school-game/v60/preload.js && node --check school-game/v60/game.js && node scripts/math-factorization-v604-teacher-static-test.js
scripts.dist:win: npm run prepare && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dir:win: npm run prepare && electron-builder --win dir --x64 --publish never

build.productName: Math Tactical Classroom V60.4 Teacher Edition

nsis.shortcutName: Math Tactical Classroom V60.4 Teacher Edition
